blocks.heading: Ooma cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Ooma against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (cloud phone, call routing, call recording) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: SMS allotments are account-wide caps (e.g. Pro ~250/mo) — not per-user unlimited. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Small businesses that want transparent monthly VoIP without annual contracts requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: SMS allotments are account-wide caps (e.g. Pro ~250/mo) — not per-user unlimited

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Call queues, CRM and auto-dialer require Pro Plus

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Roughly 15-seat cliff — larger teams often outgrow Office into Enterprise or peers
